subject.title: fix: A2A handoffs can duplicate message-tool replies

question: Should OpenClaw accept this waited A2A artifact-suppression boundary for message-tool mirror, transcript-only, and inter-session rows before merge?
rationale: The code path and proof look strong, but the patch intentionally changes which A2A transcript rows are eligible for announce and ping-pong delivery, which green CI cannot fully settle for all real channel histories.

options.title: Accept Boundary
options.body: Proceed after exact-head checks because the fix is narrow and the added Gateway/QA proof targets the duplicate visible-message failure mode.

options.title: Request Live Channel Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted live WhatsApp or equivalent channel transcript if deterministic QA harness proof is not enough for this delivery path.

options.title: Defer To Broader A2A Work
options.body: Pause this PR only if maintainers want the mirror, reverse sessions_send, and compaction-related duplicate fixes coordinated under one owner decision.

recommendation.title: Accept Boundary
recommendation.body: Proceed after exact-head checks because the fix is narrow and the added Gateway/QA proof targets the duplicate visible-message failure mode.
